biological_interpretation: A cortical NMDAR/SAPAP4 perturbation layer feeds regulated neuropeptide output, and Dlgap4 is closer to Grin1/Grin2b-like receptor-state changes than to a pan-PSD scaffold collapse.
caveats: L5 ET had significant Vgf/Adamts2 responses but the Grin2b target row itself was FDR 0.105; the L2/3 result used only 55 perturbed cells.
Only one or two non-target genes passed FDR in each engaged class.
Global score correlations were small and hypothesis-generating.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Grin2b loss produced its largest FDR-supported downstream program in cortical glutamatergic projection neurons with recurrent Vgf down-regulation; Dlgap4 loss also down-regulated Vgf, with Scg2 joining in L5 ET neurons. Parquet-verified leading rows: Grin2b->Grin2b in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.453, FDR 2.83e-21; Dlgap4->Dlgap4 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.373, FDR 1.41e-09; Grin2b->Kcnv1 in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut log2FC -1.11, FDR 2.89e-05; Grin2b->Grin2b in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut log2FC -0.376, FDR 4.53e-04; Grin2b->Vgf in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut log2FC -0.752, FDR 5.52e-04; Grin2b->Kcnv1 in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut log2FC -0.728, FDR 5.78e-04.

prior_expectation.summary: References were retained only when they were linked to one of the resolved source findings.

finding_summaries.summary: Grin2b loss produced a disproportionately large downstream response in cortical glutamatergic projection neurons, especially L2/3 IT cells.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The target was depleted in many classes, but the interpretable secondary program was concentrated in cortical excitatory neurons, arguing that GluN2B-dependent transcriptional coupling is highly cell-state dependent.

finding_summaries.direction: Dlgap4 down with sparse Vgf or Vgf/Scg2 down
finding_summaries.summary: Robust Dlgap4 knockdown resolved into two glutamatergic cell classes rather than a pan-neuronal postsynaptic-density response.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The transcriptome gave FDR-supported target engagement only in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 022 L5 ET CTX Glut, refining the known broad postsynaptic role of SAPAP4.

finding_summaries.direction: exploratory NMDA-neighbor convergence with direct-scaffold divergence
finding_summaries.summary: Dlgap4 signatures align more with NMDA receptor perturbations than with direct PSD95-SAPAP-SHANK scaffold perturbations.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: Grin1 or Grin2b appeared among the top Dlgap4 positive neighbors, whereas Dlg4, Shank3, and Grid1 were weaker neighbors despite physical scaffold membership.

resolved_evidence.description: Across the Grin2b subset, most cell types showed at least nominal depletion of the target transcript, but FDR-level target engagement was restricted to five cell types.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Grin2b was measured in all 22 Grin2b-perturbed cell types; logFC was negative in 21/22, the Grin2b row was nominal at p<0.05 in 17/22, and target FDR<0.05 in 5/22.

resolved_evidence.description: L2/3 IT cortical glutamatergic cells carried the largest Grin2b transcriptomic response, dominated by down-regulated synaptic and activity-linked genes plus a smaller up-regulated set.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 55 perturbed cells versus 7553 controls; 47 genes at FDR<0.05; Grin2b logFC -0.471, score -5.282, FDR 0.00107; Kcnv1 logFC -1.108, FDR 2.89e-05; Vgf logFC -0.987, FDR 0.0194; Adamts2 logFC 2.102, FDR 0.0118.

resolved_evidence.description: Layer 4/5 IT cortical glutamatergic cells showed a compact, entirely negative Grin2b response overlapping the L2/3 signature at Vgf, Kcnv1, Rph3a, and Diras2.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 120 perturbed cells versus 15039 controls; 6 genes at FDR<0.05 and all six were down; Grin2b logFC -0.376, FDR 4.53e-04; Vgf logFC -0.752, FDR 5.52e-04; Kcnv1 logFC -0.728, FDR 5.78e-04; Nr4a1 logFC -0.768, FDR 0.0110; Rph3a logFC -0.615, FDR 0.0110; Diras2 logFC -0.730, FDR 0.0460.

resolved_evidence.description: L5 ET cortical glutamatergic cells had a small downstream response that recapitulated Vgf down-regulation and Adamts2 up-regulation even though the Grin2b target row missed FDR<0.05.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 84 perturbed cells versus 8644 controls; 4 genes at FDR<0.05; Adamts2 logFC 1.098, FDR 0.0347; Brd9 logFC 0.453, FDR 0.0347; Arpp21 logFC 0.209, FDR 0.0495; Vgf logFC -0.755, FDR 0.0347; Grin2b logFC -0.325, nominal p=3.13e-05 but FDR 0.105.

resolved_evidence.description: Strongest on-target Dlgap4 response, with one FDR-significant downstream gene.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 262 perturbed cells vs 23679 controls; Dlgap4 logFC -0.3733, score -7.4678, p=8.15e-14, FDR=1.41e-09; Vgf logFC -0.4094, score -4.6484, p=3.35e-06, FDR=0.0289.

resolved_evidence.description: L5 extratelencephalic neurons showed on-target Dlgap4 depletion and two FDR-significant non-target decreases.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 93 perturbed cells vs 8644 controls; Scg2 logFC -1.1448, p=2.58e-07, FDR=0.00438; Vgf logFC -0.5662, p=1.30e-06, FDR=0.0111; Dlgap4 logFC -0.4102, p=5.11e-06, FDR=0.0290.

resolved_evidence.description: Screen-wide summary of measured Dlgap4 transcript engagement.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Dlgap4 was measured in all 23 cell-type tests; perturbed-cell counts ranged from 22 to 262. Dlgap4 logFC was negative in 21/23 tests, nominal p<0.05 in 12/23, and FDR<0.05 in 2/23.

resolved_evidence.description: In the strongest thalamic class, Grin1 was a nearer Dlgap4 signature neighbor than direct scaffold perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Score correlations across 17259 genes: top non-self positives Rora r=0.1794, Klf13 r=0.1718, Grin1 r=0.1609; strongest negative Gabrb2 r=-0.1489; Shank3 r=0.0707, Dlg4 r=0.0448, Grid1 r=0.0383.

resolved_evidence.description: Grin2b was a recurrent positive Dlgap4 signature neighbor in cortical glutamatergic classes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: In 022 L5 ET CTX Glut, Nobox r=0.1411, Grin2b r=0.1395, and Fezf1 r=0.1291 were the top three non-self positive neighbors across 17009 genes; Nkx6-2 was top negative at r=-0.0961; Dlg4 r=0.0483 and Shank3 r=-0.0014. In 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, Grin2b was the fourth non-self positive neighbor at r=0.0916.

resolved_evidence.description: The Dlgap4-associated Vgf decrease in L5 ET neurons aligned with Grin2b more than with direct scaffold perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Grin2b downregulated Vgf in 022 L5 ET CTX Glut, logFC -0.7546, FDR=0.0347, and in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, logFC -0.7517, FDR=0.000552. Dlg4, Grid1, and Shank3 perturbations had Vgf FDR=1.0 in both classes.

title: Grin2b and Dlgap4 losses selectively lower Vgf in cortical glutamatergic projection neurons
